title: Mike Kelley: Educational Complex Onwards 1995–2008

description.main: Edited by Anne Pontégnie and published by JRP|Ringier with Wiels and Museion in 2009, this hardcover documents Mike Kelley's projects from 1995 to 2008, centered on Educational Complex.
description.extended:
The first book to bring together Mike Kelley's projects from 1995 onward, built around Educational Complex, his architectural model of the schools he attended and the house where he grew up.

Anne Pontégnie edited the 344-page hardcover, which JRP|Ringier published in September 2009 with Wiels, Brussels, and Museion, Bolzano. Each project is documented with Kelley's own texts and reference material, across 337 color illustrations. Essays by Diedrich Diederichsen, Howard Singerman and Pontégnie discuss the shift toward systems in his work.

Kelley (1954–2012) realized Educational Complex in 1995. The projects that followed draw on autobiography, memory and reworked earlier pieces to take apart institutional structures, an interest he had begun to explore in the late 1970s.
